visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A first-person perspective shows a hand holding a black iPhone with a white messaging screen visible. Two rabbit character stickers (Usagi from Chiikawa) are shown in the chat window, along with text messages in Traditional Chinese. The lighting is bright and indoor-focused, and the camera is static. (2) The scene cuts to a medium-full shot of a young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue-green cardigan and light-colored pants. She is kneeling on the floor in a living room setting with a wooden coffee table in front of her. The background includes a beige sofa, yellow cushions, indoor plants, and a white brick-patterned wall. (3) A close-up view of the iPhone screen shows a web browser with a download prompt for an mp3 file named '蛤.mp3'. A hand with manicured nails interacts with the screen to confirm the download. (4) The screen shifts to a screen recording of the Apple App Store, displaying the GarageBand application. The orientation changes from vertical to horizontal. (5) A detailed screen recording sequence shows the user navigating the GarageBand interface. The user selects the audio recorder, imports the '蛤.mp3' file, trims the audio track on a timeline, and exports the finished project as a ringtone. (6) The view returns to a vertical phone screen showing the iOS 'Settings' menu. The user navigates to 'Sounds & Haptics' and selects the newly created '蛤' ringtone from the list. (7) Back in the living room studio, the woman celebrates by raising her phone and throwing her left arm into the air with a wide, joyful smile. Her expression is high-arousal and energetic as she looks directly at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a distinctive, high-pitched vocal sound effect 'Hah!', followed by a male voice asking with confusion where the Chiikawa sound is coming from. Upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop music with a steady guitar rhythm fades in. (2) A clear, energetic female voice takes over the narration, maintaining a high pitch and professional tutorial tone. The BGM remains constant as she explains how to set custom ringtones. The speech is fast-paced and articulated clearly. (3) As the technical steps are explained, digital UI click sound effects and subtle whoosh transitions are audible between editing phases. The BGM continues with a bright, major-key melody, providing a supportive backdrop to the constant narration. (4) The video concludes with the female narrator letting out a high-pitched, enthusiastic 'Ya-ha!' shout, mirroring the Chiikawa character sound from the beginning. The BGM reaches a final cadence and the track ends with a short fade out.

It leverages a relatable hook to introduce a technical solution using native iOS apps.
